purpose: Archive scalar-list cold entry sources, complete validation, and an unlaunched timing gate.

decision.next: Reproduce scalar ListObj read/iteration fallback with native counters before changing the helpers; cover mutation, exact values, and pin pressure.

packing: Deterministic archives preserve original member paths and bytes. Executable binaries, build/frozen caches, generated standard-library dependency trees, and the live exporter log are excluded. All source identities, validation records, expected baseline failure, the baseline and candidate test sources, codegen, methods, complete census coverage, raw semantic evidence, and all validation outcomes and the unlaunched timing gate are retained. Final complete EXPORT.txt is added after export closes.

checkpoint_filter.purpose: Make cache-free checkpoint copies while preserving the original local archives.
checkpoint_filter.note: Only generated bytecode/cache members are omitted. Every remaining source, test, input, result, failure, and method retains its original bytes. The original manifest is inside the filtered archive. Historical reports and EXPORT logs describe the original archive; use this checkpoint manifest for the committed copies.
